name: Machine Reverse-Grip Preacher Curl
steps: Adjust the preacher seat so your elbows line up with the pivot and the pad supports your upper arms.
Grasp the handles with your palms down and start with your elbows nearly straight.
Curl the handles smoothly upward toward your shoulders while keeping the backs of your hands facing upward and wrists straight.
Lower the handles slowly back toward the bottom stretch under control.
tips: Keep your wrists neutral instead of letting them fold backward under load.
Avoid lifting your elbows off the pad as your forearms fatigue.
